Analysis

Era 6 of 8

2001 to 2010: Terror, robust peacekeeping, thematic agendas

Opened by: 9/11, the women and peace agenda (1325, 2000).

Peak unity: 93% unanimous. Chapter VII in 44% of resolutions. Terrorism becomes a general threat (1373 (2001)). Women in 23%, justice and impunity in 38%. Africa 48%.

632resolutions
63per year
93%adopted unanimously
14vetoed drafts
44%under Chapter VII

Where the Council looked

Region of the situationShare
Africa48%
Middle East16%
Europe11%
Asia9%
Americas2%
Thematic4%
Institutional7%
Other4%

What rose in the texts

Subjects whose share of resolutions grew by 5 points or more on the previous era.

  • Justice and impunity: 12% to 38%
  • Women, peace and security: 5% to 23%
  • Sanctions and embargoes: 8% to 24%
  • Children and armed conflict: 6% to 21%
  • Human rights: 22% to 35%
  • Protection of civilians: 2% to 13%

Vetoes

14 vetoed drafts. No votes by permanent members on them: USSR / Russia 4, United States 10, China 2. 0 further drafts failed for lack of votes.
